name: FormLit
title: photo library and raw development on your own machine
summary: FormLit is a free, open-source photo library and non-destructive raw developer with Library, Develop, Map, Book, Slideshow, Print and Web modules.
lede: FormLit is a catalog of your photos and a non-destructive raw developer, with Library, Develop, Map, Book, Slideshow, Print and Web modules. It is local-first and runs in a browser against its local engine or as a desktop app. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can cull, develop and export through its MCP tools.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux (desktop build targets: all); also in a browser against the local engine
checks: Catalogs photos in SQLite with one revision counter and undo for every change, people and agents alike.
Decodes raw from over a thousand cameras through LibRaw, plus JPEG, TIFF, PNG, PSD, HEIC, AVIF, WebP and JPEG XL.
Develops non-destructively with one pipeline for the screen, 1:1 regions and exports, 978 built-in presets in 103 groups, masks and adjustment layers.
Runs every AI model locally on ONNX Runtime, downloaded on first use and pinned to a SHA-256.

facts.dd: Raw, JPEG, TIFF, PNG, PSD, HEIC, AVIF, WebP, JPEG XL and video
Python 3.12 and FastAPI, with a numba kernel and a numpy reference
MCP server with 80 curated tools over the engine's 280 commands

chapters.title: A catalog with culling, keywords and faces
chapters.text: Grid, Loupe, Compare, Survey and a Cull view review bursts together with sharpness, exposure and eyes-open scores. Collections, intelligent collections with nested rules, hierarchical keywords and People keep a large library organised.

chapters.title: One pipeline from screen to export
chapters.text: White balance, curves, colour mixer, colour grading, profiles, lens profiles, masks and up to eight adjustment layers per photo are rendered by the same engine for the screen, 1:1 regions and exports. 978 built-in presets in 103 groups ship with it.

chapters.title: Export, print, books, slideshows and the web
chapters.text: Export to JPEG, PNG, TIFF, PSD, JPEG XL, WebP, AVIF, HEIC or DNG. Print, build books with print-ready PDFs for Blurb, Lulu, Amazon KDP and IngramSpark, make slideshows exported as H.264, and publish web galleries.

features.title: Languages
features.text: The whole window in 26 languages, English by default (Preferences, Language).
bullets: Includes Mexican Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Canadian French and Simplified and Traditional Chinese
Standard photography terms in each language
Engine messages and preset names translated
Dates in the chosen locale

features.title: Catalog
features.text: SQLite in WAL mode with one revision counter and undo for every change.
bullets: Import in place, copy, move or copy as DNG, with rename and folder templates
Duplicate detection and eject
Folders synchronize, relocate and find missing files
Intelligent previews keep offline photos editable
Export as Catalog and Import from Another Catalog

features.title: Formats
features.text: Raw from over a thousand cameras through LibRaw, decoded to linear Rec.2020 with the camera's white balance.
bullets: JPEG, TIFF (8, 16 and float, ICC aware), PNG
PSD (8 and 16-bit), HEIC, AVIF, WebP and JPEG XL
Video with playback, trim and Capture Frame

features.title: Library
features.text: Grid, Loupe with a Navigator, Compare with linked zoom, Survey and a Cull view.
bullets: Cull view (K): bursts reviewed together, best frame starred, one key per decision
Ratings, flags and colour labels with auto advance
Collections, sets and intelligent collections with nested rules
Hierarchical keywords with synonyms, suggestions and the Painter
Faces found, clustered and named in People

features.title: Develop
features.text: One pipeline rendered by the engine for the screen, 1:1 regions and exports alike.
bullets: White balance, Basic with Auto, parametric and point curves, colour mixer and Point Color
Colour grading, B&W mix, profiles with a browser, .cube and .dcp import
Lens profiles from Lensfun and DNG opcodes, Upright, crop and Straighten
History, snapshots, copy, paste, sync and auto sync
978 built-in presets in 103 groups, with import of .xmp and .lrtemplate

features.title: Masks and retouching
features.text: Brush, gradients and range masks combined with add, subtract and intersect, plus AI masks.
bullets: AI masks for subject, sky, background, objects, people and landscape parts
Refine Edge, Shift Edge and Feather on every AI mask
Adjustment layers, up to eight per photo
Heal, clone and generative Remove (LaMa)
Red eye and pet eye, Find Dust and Visualize Spots

features.title: AI and merges
features.text: Every model runs locally on ONNX Runtime, downloads on first use, and is pinned to a SHA-256.
bullets: Denoise (SCUNet), Super Resolution and Raw Details
HDR, panorama and HDR panorama merges with deghosting
Focus stacking, astro stacking, and flash and window blending
Lens Blur from a depth map with five bokeh shapes
Search by description and Find Similar Photos with SigLIP

features.title: HDR
features.text: An HDR editing mode with headroom, previewed as PQ on HDR displays.
bullets: Visualize HDR, an SDR rendition and an HDR histogram
Ultra HDR JPEG with a gain map on export
HDR AVIF, JPEG XL and float TIFF on export

features.title: Tethering and sessions
features.text: gphoto2 on macOS and Linux, digiCamControl on Windows.
bullets: Live View and camera settings
A develop setting applied as photos arrive
Auto import from a watched folder
Sessions: a folder with Capture, Selects, Output and Trash that opens with its edits on any machine

features.title: Client proofing
features.text: File, Export Proofing Gallery makes a folder the client opens in any browser, with no account and no server.
bullets: Clients pick, reject, rate and comment
They save a small selections file
File, Import Client Selections turns it into flags, ratings, comments and a collection

features.title: Output
features.text: Export, print, books, slideshows, web galleries and publish services.
bullets: Export with sizing, output sharpening, custom ICC profiles, watermarks and presets
Books with print-ready PDFs for Blurb, Lulu, Amazon KDP and IngramSpark
Slideshows with music (up to ten tracks), exported as H.264
Web galleries with FTP upload
Publish to folders, FTP, WebDAV, Nextcloud, S3-compatible storage and Python plug-ins

features.title: Map
features.text: OpenStreetMap tiles with Hybrid, Satellite, Light and Dark styles.
bullets: Search and drag to geotag
GPX track logs
Saved and private locations
Reverse geocoding

features.title: XMP
features.text: Sidecars and embedded XMP carry the full Camera Raw settings.
bullets: Curves, profiles, lens profiles, masks, spots and red eye
Written automatically
Checked for changes made by other applications

features.title: Agents and terminal
features.text: An MCP server with 80 curated tools over the engine's 280 commands, and a terminal dock with Claude Code inside the app.
bullets: 17 workflow prompts, and setup_shoot with twelve shoot recipes
analyze_photo and match_look for measured edits
Terminal dock (Ctrl or Cmd+J) with real login shells
Claude Code button (Ctrl or Cmd+Shift+J) connected to FormLit's MCP tools

features.title: Workspace
features.text: Every panel can be shown, hidden, dragged to a new place and opened alone with Solo Mode.
bullets: Workspaces: Default, Culling: Big Grid, Editing: Wide Panels, Working with Claude, Photo Only
Save your own workspaces
Reset Panels restores the original order

parity.summary: Measured against fifty-eight Lightroom Classic capabilities, FormLit's parity page says every module Lightroom Classic has is present, from People and Map to Book, Publish and HDR output, now with adjustment layers and 26 languages. Generative and content-aware remove stays Partial, because removing reflections on glass, windows and water still has no model.

requirements: ffmpeg on the PATH for video export, slideshows and graded video
Rust stable and the Tauri 2 system packages for the desktop build
docs.agents: Add the formlit plugin from the Form marketplace, open FormLit and ask Claude; the MCP server is served at /mcp and ./formlit agents install registers it with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

topics.title: Quick Start
topics.text: The README lists requirements and the commands for macOS, Linux and Windows (formlit.bat), with a table of the frontend, engine and preview URLs.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: The engine reads backend/.env; variables such as FORMLIT_DATA_DIR, FORMLIT_LIBRARY_DIR and FORMLIT_MCP_ALLOW_DELETE are listed in the README.

topics.title: Desktop build
topics.text: ./build_app builds the desktop app from a fresh clone; flags are --lite, --open, --no-install and --clean.

topics.title: Agents
topics.text: The README explains the plugin, Claude Code inside FormLit, the Chat tab and the developer setup for Codex and Cursor.

topics.title: Parity
topics.text: docs/PARITY.md lists every module and its status, traced in code and graded by independent audits.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: The README lists what is not verified yet, including the desktop app, tethering hardware and printing.

items: The About box and the installers name NodeAgentc, Inc. as the publisher, with the Apache-2.0 licence
The updater reads its feed from the download store
The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window on PCs where the .js file type is set to text/plain
Video thumbnails, video export and slideshow video no longer need ffmpeg installed; the desktop app downloads its own LGPL ffmpeg on first run
On Linux, the .deb and .rpm recommend GStreamer's plugins and the AppImage carries the base and good ones
Windows desktop builds take --config, so FormCompiler's Windows release can carry updater files
macOS installs pin opencv-python-headless to 5.0.0.93, the version Linux and Windows use
